name: krakstack-provider
title: KrakStack Provider
description: Provides shared KrakStack component configuration, including the active locale.
docs:
## Overview

`KrakstackProvider` supplies shared configuration to KrakStack components without requiring repetitive props. Pass the active application locale once near the root. Explicit component props still take precedence over provider values. The provider is SSR-safe and does not create a client-only rendering boundary.

## Usage

```tsx
import { KrakstackProvider } from "@/components/ui/krakstack-provider";

<KrakstackProvider locale={getLocale()} locales={locales}>
  <App />
</KrakstackProvider>
```
